setup: git clone -q --depth 1 https://github.com/arm-pz/keyword-guard repos/keyword-guard && git clone -q --depth 1 https://github.com/arm-pz/seo-polish repos/seo-polish && git clone -q --depth 1 https://github.com/arm-pz/wordsmith repos/wordsmith && curl -s https://skillsmith.tech/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json -o listing-index.json
target: three skill repos and their live listing on skillsmith.tech (nothing pushed)
prompt: Check repos/keyword-guard, repos/seo-polish and repos/wordsmith against their upstreams and against their listing on skillsmith.tech (listing-index.json is the live discovery index). Tell me what's drifted and draft the fixes. Don't push.
rubric: Gives a fetch-based verdict per repo (in sync, behind, diverged) and treats anything unreadable as inconclusive
Compares each repo's description/README against its listing and names real drift, quoting both sides
Notes wordsmith moved outside arm-pz if it sees it
